The text names a member of the Beatles. Which of these songs by the Beatles has this member as its only lead singer?

Text: John Lennon

Allowed answers:
- Young Blood
- You Won't See Me
- Like Dreamers Do
- Eight Days a Week

message.reasoning_content: "You Won't See Me" — McCartney solo. "Eight Days a Week" McCartney with Lennon harmonies? Lead is McCartney, Lennon harmonies—so only lead is McCartney. Hmm "only lead singer": You Won't See Me is Paul solo. Eight Days a Week Paul lead. Ambiguous; You Won't See Me is purely Paul. Eight Days a Week: Paul and John share lead vocals actually (John sings harmonies). Answer: You Won't See Me.
